readings.note_en: “of our fathers” for “of your fathers”

readings.note_en: “the kingdom (had rest) under him” minus, only “and he had peace”

readings.note: „der König von Assur“ (Sg.) statt „die Könige“
readings.note_en: “the king of Assyria” (sg.) for “the kings”

readings.note: ויתחזק doppelt: κατισχύσῃ und καὶ κατίσχυσεν εζεκιας
readings.note_en: ויתחזק twice: κατισχύσῃ and καὶ κατίσχυσεν εζεκιας

readings.note: „und er stieg auf (bzw. erhöhte) auf die Türme“ fehlt, nur „und Türme“
readings.note_en: “and he went up (or raised) on the towers” minus, only “and towers”

readings.note_en: “and shields” is lacking

readings.note: τῆς φάραγγος „des Taltors“ statt „des Stadttors“
readings.note_en: τῆς φάραγγος “of the Valley Gate” for “of the city gate”

readings.note_en: “do not fear” minus before the similarly constructed “do not be dismayed” – probably homoioarcton (אל … ואל)

readings.note: „vor diesem Altar“ statt „vor einem Altar“
readings.note_en: “before this altar” for “before one altar”

readings.note: τὸν λαὸν αὐτῶν „ihr Volk“ statt „ihr Land“ (wie V. 14–17)
readings.note_en: τὸν λαὸν αὐτῶν “their people” for “their land” (as in vv. 14–17)

readings.note: κατέπαυσεν αὐτούς „er verschaffte ihnen Ruhe“ statt „er leitete sie“
readings.note_en: κατέπαυσεν αὐτούς “he gave them rest” for “he guided them”

readings.note: ἐπήκουσεν αὐτοῦ „er erhörte ihn“ statt „er sprach zu ihm“
readings.note_en: ἐπήκουσεν αὐτοῦ “he heard him” for “he spoke to him”

readings.note_en: וכבוד twice: δόξαν καὶ τιμήν

readings.note_en: στήλας “pillars” for “altars” (differently 2Kgs 21:3)

readings.note: הסמל doppelt: καὶ τὸ χωνευτόν „und das Gussbild“ und εἰκόνα „Bild“
readings.note_en: הסמל twice: καὶ τὸ χωνευτόν “and the molten image” and εἰκόνα “image”

readings.note_en: “and he threw (them)” minus; only “and outside the city”

readings.note_en: κατώρθωσεν “he restored (the altar)” follows the Ketiv ויכן “he set up”, not the Qere ויבן “he built”

readings.note_en: “and the carved images” minus

readings.note_en: “and (of) the inhabitants of Jerusalem”: follows the Ketiv וישבי, not the Qere “and they returned to Jerusalem”

readings.note_en: “and overseers” is lacking

readings.note_en: Plus ἀργύριον “money” and τὸ ἔργον “the work”: “all the money … to the workmen”

readings.note_en: εἰσήκουσαν “they did not listen” for “they did not keep”

readings.note_en: χελλης for “Hasrah” (cf. “Harhas” 2Kgs 22:14)

readings.note_en: “and over its inhabitants” minus

readings.note_en: ἐξεκαύθη “is kindled” for “is poured out”

readings.note: τὸν στῦλον „an der Säule“ statt „an seinem Standort“
readings.note_en: τὸν στῦλον “by the pillar” for “in his place”

readings.note_en: “(they made) a covenant in the house of the Lord” for “according to the covenant of God”

readings.note: Plus „in Jerusalem“ neben „in Israel“

readings.note_en: “in Jerusalem” is a minus

readings.note_en: τοῖς δυνατοῖς “to the mighty” for “who taught all Israel” (Qere המבינים); probably interpreted after the Ketiv המבונים

readings.note_en: διὰ χειρός “by the hand” of Solomon for “according to the writing”

readings.note_en: καὶ τὰ ἅγια “and the holy offerings” for “and sanctify yourselves”

readings.note: Plus πρόβατα „Schafe“ (wie V. 7)
readings.note_en: Plus πρόβατα “sheep” (as v. 7)

readings.note_en: Plus τὸ αἷμα: the priests sprinkled “the blood”

readings.note_en: εἰς τὸ πρωί “for the morning” (בֹּקֶר) for “with the oxen” (בָּקָר)

readings.note_en: καὶ εὐοδώθη “and it prospered” (from צלח) for “and in dishes”

readings.note_en: “and their brothers” for “and the priests”

readings.note_en: Plus “and the chiefs” alongside the gatekeepers

readings.note_en: “this Passover was kept” minus in the main clause

readings.note_en: “After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order” minus

readings.note_en: “Pharaoh Neco … against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went” for “to fight at Carchemish”

readings.note_en: ἥκω “I come” (אָתָה) for “you” (אַתָּה)

readings.note_en: “with his fathers” for “in the tombs of his fathers”

readings.note_en: “the princes and princesses” (שָׂרִים, שָׂרוֹת) for “the male and female singers”

readings.note_en: Plus “and they anointed him”

readings.note_en: “the king led him away to Egypt” for “the king of Egypt deposed him in Jerusalem”

readings.note_en: “Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king over Judah in place of his father Josiah” for “the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem”

readings.note_en: Plus name of the mother: “Secchora, daughter of Neriah, from Ramah” (Kgs: Zebidah, daughter of Pedaiah, from Rumah)

readings.note: Plus „nach allem, was seine Väter getan hatten“
readings.note_en: Plus “according to all that his fathers had done”

readings.note_en: “and his abominations … and what was found against him” minus; instead “and all that he did”

readings.note_en: “in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah” for “in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah”

readings.note_en: Plus “Jehoiakim slept with his fathers and was buried in Gan-uzza with his fathers”

readings.note_en: Zedekiah is “his father’s brother” for “his brother”

readings.note_en: “all the nobles of Judah and the priests” for “all the leaders of the priests”

readings.note: Plus „(das Volk) des Landes“
readings.note_en: Plus “(the people) of the land”

readings.note_en: “which he had consecrated” minus

readings.note: מלאכיו doppelt: „durch die Propheten“ und „seine Boten“
readings.note_en: מלאכיו twice: “through the prophets” and “his messengers”

readings.note_en: “he did not spare Zedekiah” for “he did not spare the young man”

readings.note_en: Restructuring: “their virgins they did not pity, and their elders they led away” for “virgin, old man and the very aged”

readings.note_en: “(the treasures) of the house of the Lord” minus

readings.note_en: “who had escaped the sword” minus

readings.note_en: μήδων “of the Medes” for “of Persia”
